describe.description: A large chimeric creature is shown in right-facing profile standing upright on two hind legs with two large wings fully outstretched to the sides. The upper front has a lion-like head with a thick shaggy mane, the chest and neck are covered in overlapping feather-like structures, the wings are broad and heavily feathered in brown and tan tones, and the torso, hind legs and long tail are covered in tan fur with dark rosette spots. The tail ends in a dark tuft and curves in a hook shape. The overall posture is upright and alert, with the head turned slightly to the right and the wings held open.

describe.description: A large rearing chimera standing upright on two hind legs. It has the head, ears, and shaggy mane of a male lion facing to the right, a neck and upper chest covered in overlapping brown feathers, and two large broad feathered bird wings spread outward from the sides of the upper torso. The mid-body, hindquarters, hind legs and long tail are covered in tan fur with dark rosette spots like a leopard. It balances on two muscular spotted feline hind legs ending in feline paws, with no forelimbs visible apart from the wings. A long slender spotted tail extends from the rear, curves down and back up, and ends in a dark tuft.
